pr_body:
##### Summary

If there are dots in the id of a cgroup on a child node, the dashboard on the parent node shows a truncated name for the cgroup. It happens because our current streaming protocol uses dots to distinguish chart type and id. After streaming of `type.with.dots.id.with.dots` we get type = `type` and id = `with.dots.id.with.dots`.

The solution is to replace dots with dashes in the cgroup id.

Fixes #11049
Fixes #5663

##### Component Name

cgroups plugin

##### Test Plan

1. Create a docker container on a child node with the name, containing dots: docker run -d --name "first.second.third" nginx
2. Configure streaming.
3. Check the name of the container in the main menu on the parent node - it should be `first-second-third`.

issue_context.title: Wrong cgroup names in the dashboard after streaming
issue_context.body:
##### Bug report summary

If there are dots in the id of a cgroup on a child node, the dashboard on the parent node shows a truncated name for the cgroup.

##### Netdata version

netdata v1.30.1-87-gdc567d507

##### Component Name

cgroups plugin, streaming, UI

##### Steps To Reproduce

1. Create a docker container on a child node with the name, containing dots: `docker run -d --name "first.second.third" nginx`
2. Configure streaming.
3. See the name of the container in the main menu on the parent node - it is `first` instead of `first.second.third`.

##### Expected behavior

The parent dashboard should display full names for cgroups from a child node.
